description: This file defines the EndpointProvider class within the AWS SDK for PHP, providing static methods for resolving and creating endpoint providers based on patterns or defaults, used in AWS service endpoint resolution.

classes.name: EndpointProvider
classes.description: Provides static methods to resolve endpoint providers, create default or pattern-based providers, and handle endpoint resolution exceptions.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves an endpoint using the provided provider and arguments, throwing an exception if resolution fails.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Returns the default endpoint provider, deprecated in favor of Partition.

methods.name: patterns
methods.description: Creates an endpoint provider based on specified patterns.
